name: Crowdfunding campaign manager
summary: Plans a Kickstarter or Indiegogo campaign from the pre-launch list to the final push. Sets the goal, prices the rewards and writes the page and updates.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources dated 6 Nov 2026 (Kickstarter and Indiegogo help pages, Indiegogo's Oct 2025 upgrade, EU duties and product safety, FTC case, SEC, FINRA, FCA and EU 2020/1503 with ask-a-qualified-adviser lines), four skills, six prompts, two workflows, training. Level 3 covers approved updates and emails; launch, reward terms, refunds and money need a fresh yes.
